title: When you land
body:
KIX arrivals on Nov 13 land in the evening, so plan for immigration + baggage, then a straight transfer into Osaka — no sightseeing scheduled for day one.

The JR Haruka limited express runs from the airport terminal direct to Osaka Station/Shin-Osaka (≈{{fact:haruka-kix-shin-osaka-1800-yen}} one-way) or on to Kyoto Station (≈{{fact:haruka-kix-kyoto-2200-yen}}). Basing in Osaka first, as this itinerary does, means the shorter ride. The Nankai Rapi:t express is the faster option into Namba if a hotel sits on that side of the city instead.

Buy an ICOCA IC card at a KIX ticket machine on arrival — it taps onto every train, subway and bus used on this trip, Osaka Castle vending machines included. ⚠ Confirm on arrival that physical-card sales are still running as usual; a 2023–24 chip shortage suspended some other operators' cards and coverage of ICOCA specifically was inconsistent in research — a phone-based mobile IC card (Apple/Google Wallet) is the fallback if the counter is out.

title: Local essentials
body:
Plugs are Type A/B, 100V — US devices work without a converter, just possibly slower on a hair dryer or kettle. Tipping isn't practised anywhere on this itinerary, restaurants included; leaving cash on the table more often confuses staff than pleases them.

Japan is still more cash-forward than its reputation suggests — IC cards (ICOCA) cover trains and convenience stores, but several of the food picks below (Kushikatsu Daruma, Abaraya, Kakinohazushi Tanaka) are cash-only or card-uncertain in practice. Carry cash for meals.

title: Entry & documents
body:
US passport holders enter Japan visa-free for tourism, up to 90 days — no advance application. This assumes a US passport since the intake didn't state one; if either traveler carries a different passport, check that country's own entry rule before booking, since not every nationality gets the same 90-day allowance.

Complete the digital arrival/customs declaration on Visit Japan Web before landing — it speeds up the immigration line noticeably versus the paper form.

title: Phone & data
body: ⚠ Not yet priced or verified against a current provider page — a prepaid data eSIM (Ubigi, Airalo, Sakura Mobile) or an airport pocket-wifi rental both cover this itinerary's needs. Confirm and book before departure.

title: Booking checklist
checklist: Accommodation (Osaka base; confirm walkability to a JR or subway station)
Airport transfer — Haruka or Rapi:t ticket, or buy on arrival
Houshoan (Pontocho kaiseki/wagyu-sukiyaki) — reserve via its own site; booking window and foreign-card acceptance are unconfirmed, so call ahead too
ICOCA IC card or a mobile IC wallet set up before landing
